newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Itausa still an ING buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Itausa still an ING buy.

text.p: ING Barings said in a report it was maintaining its buy rating on the preferred shares of Itausa, the holding company for Brazilian private bank Banco Itau .
-- also recommended investors switch to Itausa from Bradesco and Banco Itau due to their price appreciation of 22 percent and 14 percent, respectively, in the last month.

- said the buy rating was based "on the 19 percent discount of Itausa's market value versus the combined market value of its parts, and the stock's 28 percent under-performance versus the local index in the past three months."
- Analyst Nuno Fernandes said investors should consider Itausa as an alternative play in the Brazilian financial sector in the next 12 months.
- Itausa preferred was up 4.26 percent at 0.98 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
